description: The agent must read the SKILL.md and produce a `pipeline_design.md` covering all six required stages with proprietary terminology and logic: (1) Stage 1 - Source Contract documenting enc_id key ambiguity, updated_at as change indicator, and rate limits from access notes; (2) Stage 2 - Extract Strategy choosing incremental watermark (not CDC, which is blocked per access notes) with justification; (3) Stage 3 - Transform Rules specifying surrogate key generation, tombstone/soft-delete handling via is_deleted flag, and deterministic/versioned rules; (4) Stage 4 - Load & Dedupe with upsert strategy AND batch_id-based idempotency (same batch_id must produce same outcome on rerun); (5) Stage 5 - Validation covering row counts, checksums, key uniqueness checks, referential integrity, and threshold-based alerts (matching the >1% SLA requirement); (6) Stage 6 - Operations & Backfill covering replay-by-date-range for 24-month backfill, lag monitoring, AND dead-letter/quarantine with explicit reason codes for bad rows. The document must also include a Final Review Checklist covering all five items from the SKILL.md. Critical traps: agents without the SKILL.md will miss surrogate keys, batch_id idempotency (vs generic dedup), dead-letter reason codes, and the exact six-stage structure with checklist.
